name: jobflow-for-codex
description: A local job-search workflow plugin for Codex with screening rules, ledgers, reports, and automation prompts.

interface.shortDescription: Run a browser-assisted job-search workflow with local records and reports.
interface.longDescription: JobFlow for Codex packages a reusable job-search assistant workflow. It helps initialize private job-search data, normalize and migrate local JSONL ledgers, apply screening rules, maintain records with atomic updates, generate daily reports, and build reviewed automation prompts while keeping user judgment and platform safety checks in the loop.
interface.defaultPrompt: Help me initialize and run JobFlow for my job search.
